column1: # NeoForge -> Fabric/shim class mapping table (TSV: old_fqcn, new_fqcn, [mode])
# Rule: shim classes keep the NeoForge simple name so only import lines change.
# Phase 1 "easy" mappings — extended as phases land.
# --- fake player (Fabric API ships one; shim adapts constructor surface) ---
# unchanged: the port depends on NeoForge's standalone bus library (net.neoforged:bus, JiJ'd).
# --- registries (Phase 1: shim replays the NeoForge registration lifecycle on the mod bus) ---
# NO remap needed: Forge Config API Port (Fabric) provides net.neoforged.neoforge.common.ModConfigSpec
# and friends under their original package names. Only the registration call site changes
# which is a hand edit in the entry point, not a scripted transform.
